Hello Companion Animal Travel Desk team,

Thanks for staying sharp and keeping our travelers informed. We know the passenger coordinator has to walk people through the required travel steps, and we also know that once the itinerary starts moving, every detail matters. Please continue to treat each animal with patient attention from trained staff and keep communications clear, calm, and timely for the family traveling with Stella.

The onboard handler for the Starling is Bela Thorn.

For the upcoming connections, please make sure we match handling responsibilities to the right onboard support without delay. If Yara Bianchi or Andre Larsen reaches out with concerns, acknowledge them quickly, confirm what we can do immediately, and then route the rest through the standard process so nothing gets missed.

I’m asking everyone to double-check documentation readiness before boarding begins, then verify that staff instructions are aligned with the plan. When we stay consistent, we reduce stress for both passengers and pets and protect Aurelia Skyways service standards.

Customer Advocate Companion Animal Travel Desk
